query: How do I return a product?
ground_truth: You can return a product by contacting customer support within 30 days of purchase with your order details and reason for return.

query: What is the return window?
ground_truth: Products can be returned within 30 days of the original purchase date.

query: What items cannot be returned?
ground_truth: Perishable goods, digital downloads, and items marked as final sale cannot be returned.

query: Do I need a receipt to return an item?
ground_truth: Yes, you need proof of purchase such as your order confirmation email or receipt to process a return.

query: Can I exchange a product instead of returning it?
ground_truth: Yes, you can request an exchange for a different size or color of the same product when initiating a return.

query: How do I contact customer support?
ground_truth: You can contact customer support via email at support@company.com or by calling our helpline during business hours.

query: What are customer support hours?
ground_truth: Customer support is available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM.

query: How long does it take to get a response from support?
ground_truth: Customer support typically responds within 24 to 48 hours of receiving your query.

query: How do I escalate a support issue?
ground_truth: If your issue is not resolved within 48 hours, you can request escalation by replying to the support email with the word ESCALATE in the subject line.

query: What shipping methods are available?
ground_truth: We offer standard shipping, express shipping, and same-day delivery in select areas.

query: How long does standard shipping take?
ground_truth: Standard shipping typically takes 5 to 7 business days.

query: Is there free shipping available?
ground_truth: Free standard shipping is available on all orders above a minimum order value as specified at checkout.

query: Can I track my order?
ground_truth: Yes, once your order is shipped you will receive a tracking number via email that you can use on our tracking portal.

query: What happens if my order is damaged during shipping?
ground_truth: If your order arrives damaged, please contact support within 48 hours with photos of the damage and we will arrange a replacement or refund.

query: Do you offer international shipping?
ground_truth: Yes, we ship to a number of international locations. Shipping times and fees vary by destination.

query: What is the refund process?
ground_truth: Once your return is received and inspected, a refund will be issued to your original payment method within 7 to 10 business days.

query: Will I get a full refund?
ground_truth: Yes, you will receive a full refund for the product price. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

query: How do I get a refund for a defective product?
ground_truth: Contact support with your order number and a description or photo of the defect. A full refund or replacement will be arranged.

query: How do I cancel an order?
ground_truth: You can cancel an order within 1 hour of placing it by contacting customer support. After 1 hour, the order may already be processed.

query: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
ground_truth: You can request a shipping address change within 1 hour of placing your order by contacting support immediately.
